name: D20 Test
description: For ability checks, attacks, and saving throws, roll d20 and add applicable modifiers, comparing to a target number.

name: Difficulty Class
description: A DC is a target number for an ability check or saving throw; meeting or exceeding it succeeds.

name: Rounding Down
description: Unless otherwise specified, round down when dividing a number in the game.

name: Specific Beats General
description: A specific rule overrides a general rule when they conflict.

name: Natural 20 on Ability Checks
description: A natural 20 on an ability check is not automatically a success under 2014 5e rules.

name: Multiclassing
description: With DM permission, characters can take levels in multiple classes. Class prerequisites, proficiencies, spellcasting, and class features follow multiclass rules.
